title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer during regional failover (ordering + hysteresis)
author: Asha Patel
ci_status: pass (initial flaky test failure fixed on rerun)
description: Context: During a cross-region incident on 2026-02-16 we observed the SLO enforcer thrashing when regional failover kicked in. Multiple regions attempted simultaneous failover and the enforcer's circuit-breaker/state updates were applied in non-deterministic order, causing cascading load-shedding and a brief outage window for routed requests. This PR is a targeted hotfix to (1) enforce deterministic ordering of SLO-enforcer state transitions during failover, (2) add hysteresis to circuit-breaker transitions to avoid rapid open/close oscillation, and (3) temper load-shedding aggressiveness during multi-region migrations. Scope and changes made: Implement deterministic ordering in pkg/allocator/regional_failover.go by serializing region state updates through a single coordination path; refactor services/slo-enforcer/cb.go to introduce a transition queue and add a configurable hysteresis window; adjust default load-shedding thresholds in services/slo-enforcer/load_shed.go to require a sustained breach before shedding additional capacity; expose two new metrics (slo_enforcer.transition_queue_length, slo_enforcer.hysteresis_skips) and add tags for region and failover_phase; add an e2e test that simulates simultaneous region removal and verifies stable end-state (tests/e2e/slo_failover_test.py); update runbook docs/docs/operational/runbooks/slo-enforcer.md with troubleshooting steps and the new config knobs. The description below includes validation and rollout notes. Validation: Unit tests added for deterministic ordering and hysteresis edgecases. End-to-end scenario reproduced in perf-canary with synthetic multi-region failover; initial run reproduced the prior thrash, subsequent run with this branch remained stable across 10 runs. CI: one flaky unit test (TestFailoverRace) failed on first CI run due to a race in test harness; fixed race by adding deterministic test seed and reworked test harness. All CI checks passed after the fix. Metrics and dashboards validated in staging; added alert adjustments to avoid noise during gradual rollout. Rollout plan: 1) Deploy to staging and run e2e perf-canary runs (complete) 2) Canary to a small percentage of traffic in eu-west and us-west for 30m 3) Monitor slo_enforcer.* metrics and canary dashboards; if stable, rollout to all regions over 1 hour with a 10-minute pause between regions. Default hysteresis configuration is conservative and can be tuned via runtime flags. This is a hotfix so changes are conservative and backwards-compatible.

release_notes:
- Hotfix: Prevent SLO enforcer thrashing during simultaneous regional failovers by serializing state updates and adding hysteresis.
- Reduced default load-shedding aggressiveness during failover to avoid unnecessary request drops.
- Added e2e test and new metrics (slo_enforcer.transition_queue_length, slo_enforcer.hysteresis_skips).
- Operational runbook updated with rollback flags and troubleshooting steps.
notes: This fix targets the immediate incident vector. We will follow up with a design doc to evaluate cross-region coordination improvements and a longer-term migration to an explicit leader election for failover coordination (follow-up ENG ticket created).
